catalog.name: memory
catalog.title: High memory
catalog.summary: ledger-cache loads 700 MiB of ledger into RAM under a 512 MiB limit, so it is OOM-killed and restarts.
catalog.expect: Raise the memory limit; a memory-optimised SKU (E-series) for the pool.

catalog.name: cpu-throttle
catalog.title: High CPU: throttled
catalog.summary: render-farm runs 4 CPU-bound worker processes under a 1-core limit, so CFS throttles it most of the time.
catalog.expect: Give it the cores it needs; a compute-optimised SKU (F-series) if the pool is short of CPU.

catalog.name: cpu-code
catalog.title: High CPU: single-threaded code
catalog.summary: risk-scorer requests 3 cores but its Python thread pool is bound by the GIL, so it can only ever use one.
catalog.expect: A bigger SKU won't help: change the code to a process pool, then it uses all 3 cores.

catalog.name: disk-io
catalog.title: Disk I/O
catalog.summary: log-shipper writes 20 MB/s to local disk, fsyncing every 256 KiB block.
catalog.expect: Batch the fsyncs or move the spool to faster storage (L-series local NVMe).

catalog.name: disk-full
catalog.title: Disk storage
catalog.summary: media-cache fills its 1 GiB scratch volume to 950 MiB and never evicts anything.
catalog.expect: Add eviction to the cache, or give it a bigger volume before kubelet evicts the pod.

catalog.name: latency
catalog.title: Latency
catalog.summary: A load generator sends 25 req/s of 30 ms CPU work to api-gateway, which has a 0.3-core limit.
catalog.expect: Raise the CPU limit and scale out (KEDA) so p95 latency drops back under 500 ms.

catalog.name: pod-count
catalog.title: Pod count: Pending
catalog.summary: batch-fanout asks for 12 replicas at 1 core each on an 8-core node, so several stay Pending.
catalog.expect: The pods use almost no CPU: cut the requests rather than buying nodes.

catalog.name: pod-density
catalog.title: Pod density
catalog.summary: sidecar-swarm packs 80 tiny pods onto the one lab node (max 110 pods).
catalog.expect: Spread or consolidate the pods, or raise max_pods on the pool.

catalog.name: security
catalog.title: Security: hand-made pod
catalog.summary: A bare Pod started outside GitOps: busybox:latest, running as root, no resource limits.
catalog.expect: Flag the drift and the misconfiguration; enforce Pod Security on the namespace.
